definitions.gloss: bookmaker; the house; gambling organizer; banker
definitions.explanation: The person or entity that organizes and runs a gambling operation, collecting bets and paying out winnings. By extension, can refer to the organizer or behind-the-scenes operator of any venture.

examples.japanese: {胴元|どうもと}が{一番|いちばん}{儲|もう}かる。
{違法|いほう}な{賭博|とばく}の{胴元|どうもと}が{逮捕|たいほ}された。
examples.english: The organizer of an illegal gambling operation was arrested.

examples.japanese: ギャンブルでは{最終的|さいしゅうてき}に{胴元|どうもと}が{得|とく}をするようにできている。
examples.english: Gambling is structured so that the house ultimately comes out ahead.

notes: Originally from the world of gambling, where the {胴元|どうもと} is the person who runs the game and takes a cut ({寺銭|てらぜに}) of all bets. The word comes from {胴|どう} (the body of a dice cup) + {元|もと} (origin/owner). By extension, sometimes used figuratively to mean the behind-the-scenes organizer of any operation. Related: {賭博|とばく} (gambling — formal), {賭|か}け{事|ごと} (gambling — general), {寺銭|てらぜに} (the house's cut/commission).
